reason: This plugin is primarily a unified settings UI component for DeepSeek Harness: it supplies a shared settings tab plus host APIs so adopted plugins can declare fields and have their configuration rendered and edited in one place, rather than building separate pages. The README documents route-driven form discovery, save semantics, and a browser tab integration, while package metadata shows it is packaged as a web-capable DSH bundle. It therefore maps most directly to a navigation/settings panel utility with accompanying API support.

summaries.zh: dsh-config-form 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供统一的插件设置入口，采纳该插件的功能可在“Settings → Plugins”中自动展示声明式配置表单并进行保存。
summaries.en: dsh-config-form provides a unified plugin settings interface for DeepSeek Harness, where adopted plugins expose declarative configuration forms that users can edit from one Settings → Plugins screen.

capabilities: Expose web routes for listing, reading, and updating plugin settings forms
Render a shared settings tab and form UI for adopting plugins
Accept declarative field definitions for plugin settings (e.g., text, boolean, number, select, secret) with validation
Persist and read settings via revision-aware partial updates rather than full replacements
Store secret fields through the credentials seam instead of regular settings values
